stem: Seed formation is later found in one section of an otherwise unseeded crop. Which investigation approach is most defensible?
choices: Reconstruct possible pollen sources, timing, reproductive overlap, airflow or handling pathways, spatial distribution, and relevant records before assigning a source
Assume the geographically nearest plant caused all seed formation
Assume the cultivar spontaneously produces seed without pollination evidence
Discard the earlier scouting records because the outcome is already known
rationale: A retrospective pollination investigation should reconstruct source, pathway, timing, target, and records. Proximity alone does not establish causality.
